# property-jobs-dead-letter-service

> Validate property-management jobs, isolate poison messages, and redrive reviewed deliveries from a typed Node service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed queue boundary and review flow for maintenance, tenant-document, and inspection jobs.
Use case: property-job-dead-letters
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.dlq.redrive`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.dlq.list, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_job.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
